name: std::vector<T,Allocator>::begin, std::vector<T,Allocator>::cbegin
intro:
Returns an iterator to the first element of the vector.

If the vector is empty, the returned iterator will be equal to end().

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: libc++ backports cbegin() to C++98 mode.

examples.output:
1 2 4 8 16
Sum of nums: 31
First fruit: orange

summary: Returns an iterator to the first element of the vector.
